title: Technology Infrastructure Project Manager
description:

The Project Manager will plan, coordinate, and deliver initiatives spanning servers, storage, cloud, networking, and data center operations. Strong Project Management Skills
Agile Scrum Master Skills
Waterfall Delivery Methods
MS Project, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint
Educational background and experience in project management or business management or associated area
Ability to work with others and manage disparate teams globally
Ability to manage the successful execution of technical solutions whether by a single team or multiple teams
A proven track record in a similar role
